research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Stoke Space is developing an atmospheric re-entry vehicle with a skewed heat shield optimized for high enthalpy flow and a reusable upper stage rocket with a high pressure chamber and specialized nozzle for controlled re-entry. They work on a reusable space vehicle for long-dwell payload hosting and orbital maneuvers using pressure-fed cryogenic propulsion, and a thin-walled curved shell tank and vehicle structure. Together these efforts focus on re-entry vehicles, reusable upper stages, orbital vehicles, and lightweight structures.

overview_description.description: Stoke Space develops the Nova rocket, a fully reusable launch vehicle designed to provide affordable access to and from Earth's orbit. The vehicle features a reusable upper stage that enables on-demand access to any orbit for cargo, logistics, and asset operations. Stoke Space operates vertically integrated design and manufacturing to build and rapidly iterate on its rocket engines and structures.

product.name: Nova Rocket
product.description: A 100% reusable rocket designed for rapid turnaround and multiple missions to various orbits, including return from orbit to Earth.

product.name: Actively Cooled Metallic Heat Shield
product.description: A durable metal heat shield integrated with the upper-stage engine, cooled by liquid hydrogen to protect the rocket during atmospheric reentry for rapid reuse.

product.name: Zenith Engine
product.description: A full-flow staged combustion first-stage rocket engine using liquefied natural gas and liquid oxygen, designed for high performance and rapid reuse.

product.name: Andromeda Engine
product.description: A high-performance, rapidly reusable upper-stage rocket engine using liquid hydrogen and liquid oxygen with integrated heat shield cooling.
